0022600107.text: The Houston Rockets (2-0, first in the Southwest and third in the West) visit the Atlanta Hawks (2-0, first in the Southeast and first in the East) in a regular season game that is both teams' third game of the season. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Rockets won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 117-95 in Houston on March 20, 2026. Reed Sheppard is out for Houston with a knee bruise and is averaging 3.0 points and 15.8 minutes per game this season, while Atlanta will be without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
